description: Multi-day forecast as horizontal range bars on one shared temperature axis with gridlines — lo anchored at the bar's cool end, hi at its warm end, a small drawn weather glyph per row, and a precipitation chip that highlights when precip crosses a wet threshold. The shared axis is what makes a cold/wet day visually collapse relative to its neighbours.
